tools.name: create_branch
tools.description: Create a new git branch in the repository, optionally branching from a specific base ref rather than the current HEAD.

name.description: Name of the branch to create, e.g. "feature-login". Must be a valid git ref name.

base.description: Branch or commit to base the new branch on. Defaults to the current HEAD.

tools.name: delete_branch
tools.description: Permanently delete a git branch. This cannot be undone if the branch has not been pushed.

name.description: Name of the branch to delete.

force.description: Delete even if the branch has unmerged commits.

tools.name: list_branches
tools.description: List the branches in the repository, most recently updated first.

limit.description: Maximum number of branches to return.
